correctness.rationale: Only four divisors contribute, with coefficients H, −HP, −HQ, HPQ and respective divisibility conditions H, HP, HQ, HPQ. For t=floor(n/H) in 0,…,PQ−1, summing yields F(n)=H((t mod P)−Q floor(t/Q)). Each block [jQ,(j+1)Q) contains every residue modulo P since Q>P; its band is disjoint from the next because P−1<Q. The number of t of residue r is the difference of the floors at ((j+1)Q−1−r)/P and (jQ−1−r)/P, and each t accounts for H indices. This proves the exact multiplicities and both extrema. The first band is nonnegative and the remaining ones are strictly negative; this cutoff is within one period. The full-period term at n=HPQ makes F(HPQ)=0, and periodicity of the summands then gives period HPQ. A proposed period d with HQ≤d<HPQ contradicts F(d)<0=F(0); one with d<HQ would force all values to be nonnegative. The inspected verifier's recorded 103 tuples and 1,138,338 indices are finite corroboration, not an independent runtime reproduction or the basis of the proof.
